visual_appeal: The roster is the strongest surface; the options page and move-mode coachmark are not. Skin the Move notifications panel to the same wood fill and 2px #C6A15A outline as the alerts, instead of a flat dark rectangle floating in the dim.
Replace the empty light-grey options header slab with a 22px field, fill #1A120C, 1px #8A7040, so it matches the near-black settings panel rather than a dead bar.
Keep one button metal per window: filled bronze for actions, outlined chips for state. Blue Compact beside gold View details breaks the header.
play_next_clarity: Compact still says Full for 1d 16h, the ambiguous phrase the hero retired. Use Full since 1d 16h ago in #7DDEA2, same wording as the hero, so it cannot be read as time remaining.

The action line is doing the real work but is smaller than the waste line. Set it at 15px #F3E6C8 and the two character names at 16px in class colour; keep the waste line at 13px #8FE08A so the order of operations wins the scan.
Add the same 4px state rail used on roster rows to the NOW PLAYING strip, #FF4D4D while not banking, so the current mistake is visible before the sentence.
state_colours: RESTING chips still read as gold buttons. Chips: fill #140E0A, 1px border and label in the state hex only: full #3DDC7A, nearly #FFE066, resting #FF8A2A, outside #FF4D4D. Action buttons stay filled #6B4E2E with #F0E0C0 labels.
Colour only the percent (92%, 21%) in that state hex at 13px semibold. Leave Full in ... in #C4B49A so metadata is not another rainbow.
Nearly-full #F2C14B is too close to the figure gold. Shift the 1.5 figure to #F4E2B0 and the nearly state to #FFE066. Left rails 4px, full row height, same hex, including NOW PLAYING.
character_identity: The hero race badge is still a speck on the class circle. Overlap a 28px badge at 4 o'clock with a 2px #120C08 ring and a 1px #C6A15A rim.
Roster portraits to 40px, class badge 16px on the same dark disc. Tan class names such as #C79C6E need a 1px #120C08 outline plus the existing shadow or they turn grey on the red outside tint.
Row meta should lead with the class word in class colour before the inn, 12px, so the Le* alts separate without squinting at the icon.
default_theme: The oak stops at the title band. Paint content wells with a vertical gradient #3C2A1C to #24160F and a 1px top inner highlight #C6A15A at about 35% opacity so the bronze edge is continuous.
The close control is a red square and reads as the ElvUI X. Use a 22px disc, fill #8A6230, glyph #F4E4C4, 1px rim #E6C98A.
Compact and View details must share one control: height 22, gradient #4A3422 to #2C1E14, label #F0E0C0 13px, 1px #C6A15A.
elvui_wc3_fit: In the ElvUI roster, Compact and Unlink are Blizzard blue while View details and All accounts are Gatewood gold. Send every header and footer button through the same skinned button, height 22, label #F5E6C8, so none stay on the blue template.
The move-mode coachmark is unskinned flat black next to three wood alerts. Give it the same backdrop, title #F0D78C 14px, and 2px gold outline as those alerts.
Alert Details buttons are blue slabs on wood banners. Skin them to the roster gold button, 18px tall, so the stack can sit beside the character frame.
alerts_ux: The two logout banners repeat one instruction. If Cancel logout, then rest in an inn is up, do not also show Find an inn before you log out.
Gear exists only on the first banner. Either remove it or put an 18px close and an optional 16px gear at the same x and y on every alert, 8px from the top right.

Type ramp: title 14px #F0D78C, body 13px #F4EFE4, hearth line 12px #D9CBB2, 4px between lines, 10px inset. On the green toast, set Play Le Dette in class colour #C7A0E8 so the next actor is not the same weight as the character who just ran out.
readability: Secondary meta on #251D14 is the weak spot. Raise inn, seen, and paired lines from the current grey-brown to #D2C4AE at 12px.
Timeline axis labels to #E8DCC8 at 12px; date gutter #F0E2C8 12px. Keep night bands darker than the labels, not the other way around.
Options helpers to #B7A894 at 12px. Section headers stay #E6C36A 13px with 8px below. Legend caption NEXT BEST to #E6D7C3, counts 12px, 6px after the 10px dot.
layout_polish: Lock a 210px time column ending 8px before the chips. Chips 92px wide, right inset 12px, so 92% · Full in 19h 11m (today 23:12) cannot push NEARLY FULL.
Align the hero 1.5 right edge with that chip column. Match the NOW PLAYING bar's left x and 13px height to the roster bars; give the strip 8px 12px padding.

On the character card the 9% value reads as a short stub. Draw an 8px track the full width of the tidbit column, #1A120C, fill #FF8A2A. In options, change Move notifications from a wide blue bar to a 22px inline gold button on the same baseline as its helper, and cut the gap under the tab row to 8px.
delight: NOW PLAYING is a status report next to a hero that talks. Add one 12px #E6D7C3 aside tied to state, for example The inn is the whole plan, and drop it when the strip already says Banking rest here.
Let only the full green bar pulse opacity from 85% to 100% over 8s. No row shimmer. That is enough to make rest is going to waste felt.

The card z z Z at 14px disappears on the bronze portrait. Draw it #F4E4C4 with a 1px #1A120C shadow, 4px above the circle. Give the green toast one in-voice second line in that same register, not only Full · double XP waiting.

overall_notes: Round 2 landed the real structural fixes: one alert surface, an ordered play-next sentence, chip and legend consistency, a readable timeline gutter, and a settings page with actual hierarchy. It is a coherent addon now, not a mock. It is not a 9. The ElvUI window still mixes blue template buttons with gold skinned ones, compact still uses the ambiguous Full for wording the hero abandoned, resting chips still look like buttons, and the move-mode coachmark plus the options header sit outside the visual system. Fix those and this is close to something a demanding alt-aholic would leave enabled.
